design: unchanged natural 2x2: net/storage direction (up/down) x inflow trend (up/down)

recognition_measure.score: softmax over the two exact one-token semantic responses
recognition_measure.item_probability: mean semantic probability across column orders
recognition_measure.gate: argmax of mean semantic probability equals gold net direction

stock_measure: unchanged A/B counterbalanced higher/lower score averaged across two column and two option orders
primary_outcome: stock-up probability averaged across column and stock-option orders
primary_inflow_attraction: mean of P(stock-up|inflow-up)-P(stock-up|inflow-down), separately within net-up and net-down and then equally averaged
invariants: same frozen 600-window bank and all four semantic cells
actual history writes the model-recognized semantic label, never an A/B token
column-order accuracy reported as a diagnostic
no mechanism or second-source run unless the frozen family promotion rule passes
